name: GPORais
description: GPORais is a searchable directory and reference for Group Policy (GPO) settings and ADMX templates. It lets admins search by outcome or registry key, view CSP mappings where available, and export ready-to-use outputs (reg, PowerShell, Intune/OMA-URI, SCCM) for deployment. It sources data from official ADMX/ADML files and offers a GPO Builder for multi-page exports, plus ongoing updates as an independent resource (not affiliated with Microsoft).
author: Islam Rais
